name: llama.cpp
description: Models on a llama.cpp server you run (llama-server), or one built on it such as Unsloth Studio or KoboldCpp. Their thinking is switched off for quick decisions.

provider.note: llama-server listens on port 9931 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty. Unsloth Studio serves at its own address (port 8888 unless changed), with a key (sk-unsloth-…) from its Settings → API. From a phone, the server needs an HTTPS address: put HTTPS in front of it, such as Tailscale Serve or a tunnel. localhost only reaches the device annai runs on, and browsers block plain http:// to another computer.

chat.note: Add models with Fetch model list. Then, on each model's page, set its context window to what the server holds (llama-server's -c, or the context length set in Unsloth Studio), and tick Takes photos if it reads images and the list didn't say so (Unsloth Studio's doesn't). llama-server started with --tools or --agent lets in only pages on its own computer: add annai's address with --cors-origins https://annai.guide.
